name: Headless Chrome screenshot and page driver
description: Open a URL in headless Chrome/Chromium, optionally run JS, wait for a condition, and save PNG screenshots at desktop (1440x900) or phone (390x844, touch) size. Reports console errors, exceptions, failed requests and HTTP 4xx/5xx. Use it to check a UI change by eye instead of writing another CDP script; give steps for a multi-shot walkthrough.

url.description: http(s):// or file:// page to open

out.description: PNG path for a one-shot screenshot (not needed with steps)

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT, default 1440x900; a width under 700 emulates a phone

wait.description: seconds to settle before the shot (one-shot), default 1

eval.description: JS to run in the page before the shot (one-shot); the value is returned in evals

until.description: JS expression to wait for (up to 40 s) before the shot (one-shot)

swiftshader.description: software WebGL for pages with a map or 3D canvas on a machine without GPU Chrome

chrome.description: path to Chrome/Chromium when not on PATH (or set CHROME)

dryRun.description: show the resolved plan and Chrome path without launching

outputs: { ok, shots: [absolute PNG paths], evals: [values], problems: [console errors, exceptions, failed requests, HTTP >= 400] }
